contracts: lifecycle state has one common owner shared by HTTP and Socket rule definitions
each rule has exactly one condition and one corresponding action
the runtime actor privately owns working message, document, trace, control, and deltas
condition, action, encode, cancellation, validation, and revision failures publish no partial output
revision conflicts are attempted once and never replay the transaction
terminal control remains pending until lifecycle commit succeeds
caller abort after actor-owned commit starts does not cancel or replay actor state
